messages:
maya: dropping a small thread on first-run wizard ordering + sample thumbnails. two design choices: single-column stacked cards vs a compact grid of 3 thumbnails. which feels less overwhelming for brand-new users?

jon: grid looks modern but might overload new users. stacked cards let us narrate steps and add microcopy under each.

ravi: stacked is better for conversion in our past tests. but grid performs better for users who already know what they want. maybe default stacked, allow switching to grid?

sara: suggestion: stacked by default with a small toggle "Show more projects" that reveals the grid. keeps funnel simple but offers discoverability.

maya: accessibility note: if we have a toggle that reveals more, ensure it is keyboard reachable and that focus moves into the newly revealed grid. use aria-expanded on the toggle.

oliver: a11y checklist: 1) toggle must announce expanded state; 2) thumbnails need descriptive alt text and visible focus rings; 3) ensure heading order: H1 welcome, H2 "Get started", H3 card titles.

jon: microcopy idea: card CTA "Use this sample" vs "Start with this". shorter wins. also add a tiny hint under the title: "pre-configured with prompts + evals" for power users.

ravi: analytics: add events sample_impression, sample_select, sample_use_mode (new_user vs returning). sara will wire telemetry.

sara: will add keys: sample.impression, sample.select, sample.use_mode. will gate impressions so A/B doesn't double count.

maya: performance note: lazy-load images and use 16px placeholders to avoid CLS. default to low-res SVG placeholder and swap to real image when in viewport.

oliver: focus management: when user selects "Use this sample" open the quickstart drawer and move focus to the primary action inside the drawer. include an accessible close button and trap focus while drawer is open.

maya: decision summary: stacked cards default, optional "Show more projects" toggle -> reveals grid; toggle must use aria-expanded and move focus; lazy-load images; specific telemetry keys; microcopy to be "Use this sample".

deploy-bot: reminder: onboarding design freeze Fri 5pm PT. link final comps to ticket.

jon: i'll update figma with the toggle and new copy by Thu. tagging oliver for final a11y sweep. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all, leaving thread open for any last UX nits.
